name: Gated Slot Attention · GSA + QK-norm
tagline: Bound q/k features before gated slot-memory addressing.
description: Two gated states map keys to 64 slots and slots to values, with per-head QK normalization before SiLU features and softmax addressing.
paperTitle: Gated Slot Attention for Efficient Linear-Time Sequence Modeling
mechanism: 64 slots with a shared per-slot decay/write gate in both memory stages
Per-head QK RMSNorm × 1.2, SiLU features and softmax slot addressing
24 layers; chunk128 FP64 recurrence with the native output normalization and shell
limitations: Single seed 42 with the QK-normalized common-shell adaptation. The contribution includes the result and frozen-source fingerprints. A trainable implementation for this run is not included.
